## What changed

- [ ] One small vertical slice
- [ ] A regression or acceptance test accompanies the change

## Research fidelity

- Source files / experiment artifacts:
- Manuscript section or figure affected:
- Are all displayed numbers traceable to the repository outputs?
- Does this change preserve the canonical dataset and methods?

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check:research-lab`
- [ ] `npm run research`
- [ ] `npm run figures`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run validate`
- [ ] `npm run smoke`
- [ ] Latest GitHub Actions run is green

## Failure investigation (complete when a check failed)

- Symptom:
- Root cause:
- Regression test:
- Fix:
- Rerun result:

## Product and safety review

- [ ] Responsive layout and keyboard access considered
- [ ] Loading / error / empty states considered
- [ ] Synthetic-data disclosure remains visible
- [ ] No crime forecasting or operational guidance is implied
- [ ] No private or real incident data was introduced
- [ ] Legacy dashboard changes are intentional and documented
